ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 24.5

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 66
   D. 34

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 42

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 30

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 14

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 36

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 105
   D. 30

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 18
   C. 22
   D. 36

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 13

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22
